text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Taiki! I know there's no way I can beat
you when
it comes to toughness, but!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about speed, then it's a
whole
different story! Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh?! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to races, sprints are an
entirely different beast. Runners pour
their all into a
battle that lasts but an
instant. And in the end...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Seeking the Pearl's decision was
right.
She triumphs over Taiki Shuttle,
the world
champion.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I knew I could do it! I knew if I
believed
in the power of my possibilities,
I could even beat
Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But it's not just me. We can all do it! Anyone can overcome challenges as long as they recognize the possibilities they possess and hone them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
People of the world, burn this truth into
your
minds! This victory is proof of
everyone's
potential!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl... Ya sure were fast...
You were just
like
lightnin'!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The winner is Seeking the Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Was Taiki Shuttle caught off guard? But

considering the race conditions, I guess
it's no
surprise she lost!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The race conditions? And how was this
"no
surprise"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl falls silent,
and the joy
on her
face is quickly obscured by her
busy thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see. If I think about it... everything
does seem to
have been reversed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, everything about the Sprinter
Stakes is the
complete opposite of the
Prix Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You said yourself that the race distance
of 1,600 meters, the deep turf, and the
soft ground of the
European tracks all
play against me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today, we had the exact opposite
conditions. The race was 1,200 meters,
and it was held on
Japan's short turf and
firm ground...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Everything was working for me today. All I did was beat Taiki under conditions that were stacked heavily in my favor.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A win is a win. Winning against Taiki is
amazing,
but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can I really say I surpassed Taiki as a
racer and
gave the world hope with a
victory like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...When she puts it that way, I realize
she's right. I
think about what the
announcer said after the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But considering the race conditions, I
guess it's no
surprise she lost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's unlikely many people will be
convinced Seeking the Pearl managed to
best the world
champion from this single
match alone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't mean anything unless I've
obviously
surpassed her might. What I
desire...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is for people to believe. If they don't
believe in
potential, then their actions
won't change.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In which case, the gleaming light we're
chasing
after...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, it can still shine brighter,
can't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...She has a point. This is nothing more
than one
victory claimed under
favorable conditions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't make an impression on people
unless
she wins against Taiki Shuttle on a
level playing
field.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've overcome countless obstacles
before, but this
next challenge will be
different...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This time, I must go against Taiki and
scale the wall that was built by my very
own health condition, all for the sake of
proving my
potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm going to run against Taiki in
the Mile
Championship!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat her over the distance
she excels at—one that I can just barely
complete. I'm going
to crush her in a
1,600-meter race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There, I'll turn my speed into true
strength, like
unlocking my hidden
potential at the end of a
rainbow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is a very big decision. If she can
beat Taiki
Shuttle in a mile race despite
her respiratory
condition...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll send an extremely clear message
to the rest of the world—it's possible to
surpass both your
health conditions and
destiny itself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not so foolish that I don't know the
difference
between being courageous
and being reckless...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I sat out the Prix Jacques Le
Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But is this challenge reckless? Is it
nothing more
than a foolhardy venture
doomed to sink?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
People might ask these questions, but
you know
what I think? I think I can do
it! What about you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly how skilled Seeking the
Pearl is. Now I have to use that
knowledge to decide what
we should do
next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think about Seeking the Pearl and what
she lives
and strives for every day, and
when I consider all
that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One more time. Say it again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One more time! Louder!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! Now listen
closely,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My chances of winning are close to zero.
This
victory isn't part of my destiny.
But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There are things you can achieve if you
just
believe. I believe this is why we met
all that time
ago.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're in this together. So will you join
me in
bringing light to this world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly. I feel exactly the same way
she does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe in the possibilities of 
Umamusume—the possibilities of people.
And to do that, we'll have to leave an
indelible and everlasting mark at the
Mile Championship.
